introHtml: Baseball noise makers are designed to withstand the energy of the stands, from plastic clackers to mini bats and cowbells. Whether you're outfitting a little league team or promoting a minor league game, these giveaways keep fans engaged through every inning. Choose from imprintable foam fingers, thunderstix, or hand clappers that can be decorated with screen printing or a full-color wrap. Durable enough for repeated use, they make your brand part of the action.
